title: A zone's camera boundaries: res/field/cameras/boundaries/<n>.json
description: Boundary set n of ARCID_FIELD_CAMERA_MAP_BOUNDARY (a/1/0/9), which a zone names by its "cam_bound" (65535 for none) and FieldCameraBoundary_LoadFile reads: each boundary keeps the camera's target or eye inside a rectangle or a circle, or out of a rectangle, on the X-Z plane. tools/data/field_camera_data.py packs them in order.

boundaries.description: The boundaries, applied in order; the camera has room for four

shape.description: What the boundary does, by FieldCameraBoundary_RestrictRect, _RestrictCircle and _RepealRect; none does nothing

apply_to.description: Whether the boundary moves the camera's target or its eye

angle_a.description: With angle_b, the arc of the circle that holds the camera, in 65536ths of a turn; the whole circle when they are equal

whole.description: A rectangle's side, in whole units, which the game shifts into fixed point

fx32.description: In 4096ths of a unit, as the game's fixed-point numbers
